steps: Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas.
Peel the garlic clove. Put the tahini, the lemon juice and the garlic in a food processor and run 30 seconds, until pale and creamy.
Add the chickpeas and half the water. Run 1 minute, scraping down the sides once.
With the motor running, pour in the olive oil and the remaining water. Blend 1 minute more, until smooth and silky.
Taste; add a spoon of water if it is thicker than you like.
Spread thin on toast fingers under 12 months, or serve with soft cooked vegetable sticks. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
